document_api_meta.title: Search CAP Affiliate Orders
document_api_meta.env_desc: Search affiliate orders for an MCN (Creator Agency Partner) within the specified or default creation-time range. When multiple request-body filters are provided, `order_id`, `product_id`, `settle_status`, and the creation-time range are combined using AND semantics, so an order must match every supplied filter.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The partner access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 3. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3978f4c20311b8b555) to get partner access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: Pagination token returned in `next_page_token` from the previous response. The token contains only the search-after sort position; it does not preserve the search filters or `page_size`. Omit this parameter for the first page. For each subsequent page, pass the returned token, provide a valid `page_size`, and resend the same partner authorization context and request-body filters used for the first page. The `page_size` value can be set independently for each page. For stable pagination, explicitly provide the same fixed `create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` values on every request instead of relying on the rolling default time range.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc: The default is 20, it must be positive integer, the range is 1-100

request_query_param.name: category_asset_cipher
request_query_param.desc: The partner identifier used in API requests. Retrieve this value by using the [Get Authorized Category Assets API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/666012dd609d4402cc3be995).

request_body_param.name: settle_status
request_body_param.desc:
Filter orders by settlement status. Send one of the following integer values; the response `settle_status` field uses the corresponding label:
- `1` → `CUSTOMER UNPAID`: The customer has not paid for the order.
- `2` → `PENDING`: The customer can still return the order or request a refund, so earnings are estimated and awaiting settlement.
- `3` → `SETTLED`: Earnings have been settled to your account.
- `4` → `INELIGIBLE`: The order was returned, refunded, or canceled, so no commission will be settled.
- `5` → `FROZEN`: Possible fraud was detected; the commission will be unfrozen after the fraud is resolved.

request_body_param.name: create_time_ge
request_body_param.desc: Filter orders created at or after this time. Unix timestamp in seconds. `create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` must be provided together. An explicitly supplied range can span at most 92 days. If neither field is provided, the API searches from three calendar months before the request time through the request time.

request_body_param.name: create_time_lt
request_body_param.desc: Filter orders created before this time. Unix timestamp in seconds. `create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` must be provided together.

response_param.name: ^sku_orders
response_param.desc:
SKU orders returned for the current page.

For monetary fields whose names start with `actual_`, the nested `amount` can be present only when `settle_status` is `SETTLED` or `INELIGIBLE`. For all other statuses, the `amount` property is omitted. Even for `SETTLED` or `INELIGIBLE` orders, an individual `actual_*` field can still omit `amount`.

response_param.name: ^^settle_status
response_param.desc:
Settlement Status of the order.
Possible values:
1. "CUSTOMER UNPAID",  customer hasn't paid for the orders.
2. "PENDING", customers can still return or get a refund for this order. The earnings shown are estimates and waiting for settlement.
3. "SETTLED", your earnings have already settled to your account
4. "INELIGIBLE", The order has been returned/refunded/canceled by the buyer, and no commission will be settled.
5. "FROZEN", Possible fraud has been detected regarding the order. The commission will be unfrozen after the fraud is resolved.

response_param.name: ^next_page_token
response_param.desc: Pagination token for the next page. The token contains only the search-after sort position; it does not preserve the search filters or `page_size`. If this field is returned, pass it as `page_token` in the next request, provide a valid `page_size`, and resend the same partner authorization context and request-body filters used for the first page. The `page_size` value can be set independently for each page. For stable pagination, explicitly provide the same fixed `create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` values on every request instead of relying on the rolling default time range. Stop paginating when this field is omitted. The field is omitted when the returned page contains fewer records than `page_size`.

response_param.desc: Total number of SKU orders matching the current search criteria across all pages.
